recap.text: Carl watches a recording of a boy named Asher and realizes he had a half-brother. The Reminiscence Hydra features Asher's face as a lightning head, which Shi Maria swallows and bites off. Carl learns Beatrice knew about Asher and kept it from him. He decides to make the brother he never knew proud.

Imani lectures Bucket Boy about pain levels while Carl thinks of his half-brother Asher. He remembers Asher's mother holding him after she poisoned their father. Carl thinks of Princess Donut sobbing at the end of the Butcher's Masquerade and notes that they must do horrible things to survive.

beats.headline: The boy behind the hospital bed
beats.text: Subject: a boy of perhaps six, in a recording from the summer before the collapse. He stays behind the hospital bed, out of his father's sightline, and asks whether he can watch television now. Told to fetch cigarettes, he runs. "Asher! Get back here you little shit!" The photographs on the curio: a one-year-old on his father's lap, and a recent one with brown hair enough for two people, blue eyes, and that nose. Crawler Carl's conclusion takes four words: I had a brother.
beats.gist: A recording shows Asher, a six-year-old boy, who runs when told to fetch cigarettes.

beats.headline: Crayon drawings of lightning storms
beats.text: While his mother is busy with the syringe, Asher lies on his bed running a matchbox car up and down the wall. Crawler Carl tells him he is sorry he did not know, and that he is not forgotten. His hand goes through the boy's head. He takes the toys and the crayon drawings, airplanes and storm clouds whose lightning destroys whole cities, and concludes the boy is scared of storms. He leaves the heart-shaped candy box. His mother hugs him and mentions a birthday party. "Am I going to get a bike?" "We'll see, honey."
beats.gist: Carl tells Asher he is not forgotten, but his hand goes through the boy's head.

beats.headline: The lightning head
beats.text: The youngest face on the Reminiscence Hydra is Asher's. It asks, amplified and much louder than a child, "Carl, why didn't you ever visit me?" and then opens its mouth and fires lightning. It is the lightning head: the resistance and the attack. The other heads swing in to take the bombs meant for it, as though protecting it. Crawler Carl keeps telling himself it is not really the boy, and keeps throwing bombs at it; the other heads keep catching them.
beats.gist: The Reminiscence Hydra has a lightning head with Asher's face that fires lightning at Carl.

beats.headline: Shi Maria takes the head
beats.text: Carl, on fire, thinks one thing: get the boy's head out of this, fast. Shi Maria turns her corkscrew neck and asks which of these morsels is Asher, third eye open. She finds it. "Carl, I wish I'd known you, too," the Asher head calls, just before it is swallowed and bitten off. Three heads remain. The spider's message follows: the echo of your kin has been muffled. He rests. I have done something for you, she adds, and soon Carl is to do something for her.
beats.gist: Shi Maria swallows and bites off the head of Asher while Carl is on fire.

beats.headline: Collected in the collapse
beats.text: Crawler Carl works it out afterwards. Everyone on that hydra was dead: people collected in the initial collapse, his friend Sam, his landlord Mr. Roth, who lived alone, died alone. His father was not on it because his father was already gone. Asher and his mother were on it, which means they had been gone the whole time. Carl knew that was the likeliest outcome for everybody. The file has nothing that contradicts him.
beats.gist: Carl learns Asher and his mother died in the initial collapse on the hydra.

beats.headline: Bea knew and kept it
beats.text: Princess Donut recognised every head, the boy included: Beatrice had his picture on her phone and talked about him with her mother, who said to ignore the whole thing. Donut assumed a nephew. Carl corrects her: half-brother. Donut works out whose son that makes him. Carl works out the rest. The stepmother must have written to him, probably on Facebook. Bea saw it and never told him. Even after the cheating he had never been angry at her. He is now.
beats.gist: Princess Donut recognizes Asher's head; Carl reveals Asher is his half-brother. Carl becomes angry at Beatrice.

beats.headline: Someone to make proud
beats.text: The eighth floor is stripped into the sky with Crawler Carl inside it, and what he thinks of, looking down on the memories of people who do not know how few days they have, is Asher, the brother he never knew. He needs to make the boy proud. He was not there for him while he lived. He means for the boy's death not to be for nothing.
beats.gist: Carl looks down on memories and wants to make his dead half-brother Asher proud.

beats.headline: She's a child, too
beats.text: Imani is lecturing Bucket Boy about pain levels, and Crawler Carl is not listening. He is thinking of his brother, and of Asher's mother holding him after she poisoned their father, and of Princess Donut sobbing at the end of the Butcher's Masquerade. She's a child, too, he thinks, and then another: they are going to have to do some pretty horrible things just to survive. He has an order to compose.
beats.gist: Carl thinks of Asher's mother poisoning their father while Imani lectures Bucket Boy about pain levels.

relations.note: She knew about him and did not tell Carl
